data.name: Observability_Quota_CodexKept

data.value: Read from Codex now, without a model turn.

data.name: Observability_Quota_CodexNotAllowed
data.value: Codex says ordinary use is not allowed now.

data.name: Observability_Quota_NotExposedDefault
data.value: Codex does not offer it here

data.name: Observability_Quota_NoPermission
data.value: Nothing was launched without your permission.

data.name: Observability_Quota_Intro
data.value: The percentage of use is always the one the agent program reports: Agent Studio neither calculates nor guesses it.

data.name: Observability_Quota_ReadCodex
data.value: Check the usage limit of Codex

data.name: Observability_Quota_ReadCodexTip
data.value: Reads the usage limit of Codex once, with its session and without a model turn. Only with your permission in "Settings".

data.name: Observability_Settings_Intro
data.value: The monitor warns when the working memory of a task is filling up. Here you also decide whether Agent Studio may read the usage limit of Codex.

data.name: Observability_Settings_Rule
data.value: Each threshold is higher than the one before and the last one is at most 100: 0 < warning < compression < critical ≤ 100. They are measured on the working memory of the model that served each step.

data.name: Observability_Settings_CodexRead
data.value: Read the usage limit of Codex

data.name: Observability_Settings_CodexExplanation
data.value: It reads your usage limit with the Codex program and your ChatGPT session, without any model turn. It is read when you ask and after each Codex run, at most once every 5 minutes. If a run waits for a Codex limit, it is read to learn the reset time and before going on.

data.name: Observability_Settings_NotWhole
data.value: The thresholds were not saved. "{0}" is not a whole number from 1 to 100: fix it.

data.name: Observability_Settings_BadOrder
data.value: The thresholds were not saved. Each one must be higher than the one before, and the critical one cannot be over 100: 0 < warning < compression < critical ≤ 100.

data.name: Info_Quota_What
data.value: How much of your plan you used in each period, like the last 5 hours or 7 days. The percentage comes from the agent program. Agent Studio does not calculate it.

data.name: Info_Quota_Actions
data.value: Look at each bar: it says what percentage you have used and where it comes from. Look under the bar for when the limit resets. Press "Check the usage limit of Codex" to read it now, if you allowed it in "Settings".

data.name: Info_ContextSettings_What
data.value: The monitor warns when the working memory of an agent fills up. Here you choose at which percentage each warning goes off: the warning, the recommended compression and the critical one.

data.name: Info_ContextSettings_Actions
data.value: Change the three percentages. Each one must be higher than the one before. Save the settings to apply them. Turn on reading the usage limit of Codex only if you want to see it in the bars.
